accepted.title: Vanishing of all degree-two cup products in free-group bounded cohomology
accepted.text: For every non-abelian free group F, is the cup product H_b²(F;ℝ)×H_b²(F;ℝ)→H_b⁴(F;ℝ), with trivial real coefficients, identically zero?
accepted.subject: Geometric Group Theory & Bounded Cohomology

accepted.title: Characterizing stable commutator length one-half in free groups
accepted.text: Let F be a non-abelian free group and f∈[F,F] satisfy scl_F(f)=1/2, where cl_F(g) is the minimum number of commutators multiplying to g and scl_F(g)=lim_{n→∞}cl_F(gⁿ)/n. Must either cl_F(f)=1 or there exist t∈F with cl_F(ftft⁻¹)=1?
accepted.subject: Geometric Group Theory & Bounded Cohomology

accepted.title: Primitivity-rank lower bound for stable commutator length
accepted.text: For every non-abelian finitely generated free group F and nontrivial w∈[F,F], does 2 scl_F(w)≥π_F(w)−1 hold? Here scl_F(w)=lim_{n→∞}cl_F(wⁿ)/n, and π_F(w)=min{rank(K):K≤F,w∈K,and w is not part of a free basis ofK}, with the minimum∞ if no suchK exists.
accepted.subject: Geometric Group Theory & Bounded Cohomology

accepted.title: Equivalence of the Gromov and finite-vanishing seminorms on free-group bounded cohomology
accepted.text: Fix a non-abelian finitely generated free group F. For every integer n≥3, is there C_n>0 such that C_n⁻¹‖α‖∞≤‖α‖∞,0≤C_n‖α‖∞ for every α∈H_bⁿ(F;ℝ)? Here ‖α‖∞ is the infimum of supremum norms of bounded cocycle representatives. In the homogeneous complex Cⁿ⁻¹(F)^F of invariant real functions on Fⁿ, set ‖α‖_S=inf{‖δφ‖∞:φ∈Cⁿ⁻¹(F)^F,[δφ]=α,and φ|_{Sⁿ}=0} for finiteS⊂F, and ‖α‖∞,0=sup_{S finite}‖α‖_S; an empty infimum is∞.
accepted.subject: Geometric Group Theory & Bounded Cohomology

accepted.literature_finding: FFPS defines the second seminorm and proves it dominates the first. Its constructed continuum-dimensional zero subspace has both seminorms zero, so that theorem is not a counterexample to equivalence. Lemma2.4’s infinity result is degree2, deliberately excluded. No dated primary closure of the n≥3 free-group comparison was identified; recommend withB grade.
